description: `listVolumeAutomations`, `listVolumeExecutions` and `listVolumeTemplates` take `pageToken` and `pageSize` and answer `nextPageToken` beside `items`. The spec's text says a response with no `nextPageToken` is the last page. The converter only recognizes page-number pagination, so none of them got a paginated surface, and a caller reading one page would miss what's on the others. Read from the spec 2026-11-01.
